mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP450 enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2C9, others) and glucuronidation pathways, reducing nafcillin metabolism and clearance, potentially decreasing nafcillin efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response closely; nafcillin levels may be subtherapeutic; consider alternative antimicrobial or increased nafcillin dosing, and reassess after rifampin discontinuation.
